components.name: Archive Detail Contract
components.description: The archive-world CSS scope remains for calm warm-paper detail: two-column desktop layout, identity-first mobile order, unboxed valuation/metadata/history, and sensible chart width.

narrative.overview: Home is a calm restrained warm-paper surface for ordinary collectors: find a card, inspect honest value evidence, movement, and freshness, then use the unchanged two-sided decision bench in Trade/Sealed. Archive-world remains the CardDetail CSS scope with superseded orange/boxed treatments replaced by coherent warm-paper detail.
keyCharacteristics: Warm square identity with restrained separators, no noise texture, and selective official Fluent UI System Icons Regular.

Rise #27714b and fall #a6402f are intentional accessible positive/negative directional evidence colors on paper; derived warm art and state backgrounds use color-mix from documented paper, bench, and orange tokens rather than new literal colors.
Barlow Condensed action hierarchy with Azeret Mono for body and evidence.
Accessible mode switch, direct Find a card search, honest unavailable Sealed mode, compact Price movement, collapsed icon-led Method details, and one reveal motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Keep Home scoped by home-world; shared Trade/Sealed decision-world styling remains unchanged, and archive-world remains the CardDetail CSS scope.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Show exact identity, discriminators, source/methodology, and current/fresh, stale, or unpriced status without fabricated precision.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Give each screen one primary task/action hierarchy with generous surrounding space; contextual result-row CTAs do not compete with it. Use 48px targets, 4.5:1 normal text contrast, and clear keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Use the shared external 250ms CardAutocomplete hook so query, input node, focus, caret/selection, and composition survive result updates; keep active options stable, visibly ruled, and internally scrollable.

rules.name: The Trade Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep two symmetric square ledgers, exact identity, 48px controls, visible acquisition status, stale/unpriced honesty, and no implied share/copy or PLN capability before those pieces exist.

rules.name: The Spatial Rule
rules.body: Use the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64px scale on an 8px core grid, a canonical 1152px (72rem) desktop container, 48px major section spacing, 24-32px actual card/panel spacing, and mobile-first stacking with 33-50% lower spatial density.

rules.name: The Row Density Rule
rules.body: Compact price and evidence rows are rows, not cards, so their intentional 12-16px padding exception keeps repeated evidence scannable while actual panels/cards retain 24-32px spacing.

dos: Do keep Singles as the default Home mode and state Sealed honestly unavailable.
Do use calm square geometry, warm paper/bench/ink tokens, selective semantic icons, and vertical price rows without heavy perimeter borders.
Do preserve the archive-world contract on card detail.
Do keep complete methodology, policy, non-affiliation, shipping, and unavailable-price caveats hidden by default in collapsed Method details.
Do provide one bench-reveal motion and disable it for reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply sealed, PLN conversion, share/copy controls, seller-count, language, condition, finish, or Poland-shipping capability.
Don't hide stale or unpriced estimates behind decorative treatment.
Don't replace either scoped world with generic rounded marketplace cards, glass, or gradients.
